## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Use case

What is the use case for this feature? (academic / industrial / clinical)

## Substrate-specific transporter mining support

If you're requesting support for a new substrate, please provide:
- Substrate name + literature references for known transporters
- TC classes likely involved (link to TCDB hierarchy if possible)
- Description keywords (TCDB-curated preferred)
- Initial reference set (5-25 known accessions, or 0 if no literature exists)
- Expected use case (academic / industrial / clinical)

## Additional context

Any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.
